⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Multi-resolution waveform summary buckets for an audio source.

Each row stores one batch of summary buckets. The `bucket_start`,
`bucket_duration_samples`, `min_amplitude`, and `max_amplitude` arrays are
parallel arrays and should have the same length. Optional arrays such as
`rms_amplitude` and `activity` are also parallel when present.

These summaries are durable derived data: they can be logged, cached,
queried, exported, and rendered without decoding source audio on every pan
or zoom.

## Fields
### Required
* `bucket_start`: [`AudioTimestamp`](../components/audio_timestamp.md)
* `bucket_duration_samples`: [`AudioDurationSamples`](../components/audio_duration_samples.md)
* `min_amplitude`: [`Scalar`](../components/scalar.md)
* `max_amplitude`: [`Scalar`](../components/scalar.md)

### Recommended
* `rms_amplitude`: [`Scalar`](../components/scalar.md)
* `activity`: [`Scalar`](../components/scalar.md)

### Optional
* `source_id`: [`AudioSourceId`](../components/audio_source_id.md)
* `audio_reference`: [`EntityPath`](../components/entity_path.md)
